title: gps
description: v0.1 device-model entity: position fix from a USB GPS/GLONASS/BeiDou (NMEA 0183) module, read directly by the renewvan/node-gps node (sensing, not a feed remap). Published under renewvan/gps/<id>/<property>. Every field is live -- republished on every poll (default 3s), no identity/startup-only fields. fix_quality/satellites_in_use/avg_snr_db are unconditional (avg_snr_db absent only before the first GSV sentence is decoded); every position/motion field is present only once a fix is acquired (fix_quality != no_fix).

fix_quality.description: Mapped from the GGA sentence's fix-quality field (0-8). 'no_fix' means no satellite lock yet -- every other field is absent in that state.

satellites_in_use.description: Number of satellites used in the current fix, from the GGA sentence. 0 when fix_quality is no_fix. Unconditional live field.

avg_snr_db.description: Mean carrier-to-noise ratio (C/N0, dB-Hz) across every satellite with a decoded SNR value in the GSV sentences seen during the poll, any constellation. Independent of fix_quality -- raw signal tracking is meaningful even before/without a fix, e.g. diagnosing "I have satellites in view but not enough signal for a fix". Not restricted to the fix_quality subset: it includes every tracked satellite, not only the ones GGA used for the fix. Absent only before the node has decoded its first GSV sentence.

latitude.description: Decimal degrees, WGS84, positive north. Present only when fix_quality != no_fix.

longitude.description: Decimal degrees, WGS84, positive east. Present only when fix_quality != no_fix.

altitude_m.description: Altitude above mean sea level, meters (GGA sentence). May be negative (below MSL). Present only when fix_quality != no_fix.

hdop.description: Horizontal dilution of precision from the GGA sentence; lower is better. Present only when fix_quality != no_fix.

speed_kmh.description: Ground speed in km/h, converted from the RMC sentence's knots field (1 knot = 1.852 km/h). Present only when fix_quality != no_fix.

course_deg.description: Track made good, degrees true (RMC sentence). Present only when fix_quality != no_fix.

fix_time.description: UTC timestamp of the fix (RMC sentence's date+time fields), ISO-8601 with explicit +00:00 offset -- the GPS clock is always UTC, never localized. Present only when fix_quality != no_fix.
